description: This file defines the AdaptiveRoundingOptimizer class which implements an optimization routine for quantizing and adaptive rounding of neural network models, primarily for quantization-aware training and optimization in PyTorch. It contains methods for running adaptive rounding, data collection, and loss computations, and interacts with external modules related to quantization and fake quantization.

classes.name: AdaptiveRoundingOptimizer
classes.description: Class responsible for performing adaptive rounding optimization on neural network models for quantization purposes in PyTorch. It manages data preparation, running optimization routines, and applying quantization adjustments.
